name: known-gap-adtech-exclude-cannot-fire
reason: The 'adtech' hard exclude cannot fire on an adtech JD. prefFieldsFor routes an anti_pattern preference at domain, work_type, culture_signals, and required_skills -- and 'adtech' appears in none of them, because `domain` is a closed enum with no adtech value and the industry is only ever named in screening_summary.industry. #53 gave the DOMAIN branch that field; the anti_pattern branch still does not read it, and this row is typed anti_pattern. That points at two possible fixes and they are different: retype the row to domain (a sample-data change, and arguably right -- adtech is an industry, not an anti-pattern), or give anti_pattern the screening fields (#48 proper, which also wants location and clearance). database/sample/README.md claims this fixture 'fails the gate outright on the adtech hard exclude'; it does not. This is the hard-exclude fixture's entire reason for existing, so it is the highest-value gap in the set.
